mprNestedFamilyParamsTransfer.Description: Simplifying the association between nested family parameters and parent family parameters
mprNestedFamilyParamsTransfer.FullDescription: Creating new parameters in the parent family based on one or more parameters of nested families. A name mask can be set for the created parameter by adding a prefix or suffix. Setting and deleting links to existing parent family parameters is also available
